name: Locha

attributes.attribute: the cattle raid epic in which Lord was killed

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Locha is an Irish heroine who served as handmaiden to a queen. She waited on Medb of Connacht in the old tales. She was killed during the great cattle raid on Ulster, set out in the Irish epic the Táin Bó Cuailnge. The record keeps her among the many lesser figures who died in that war.

okr.objective: Tell the small part of In the great cattle raid.
key_results: Call Locha an Irish heroine and handmaid.
Name Medb of Konny as the queen she attended.
Report her death during the day the cattle raid on Ulster.
